title: Study on the adsorption performance of coal gangue-loaded nano-FeOOH for the removal of Pb2+, Cu2+, and Cd2+ from acid mine drainage
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22161-22178
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03306C, Paper
Open Access

Xuying Guo, Xiaoyue Zhang, Zilong Zhao, Yanrong Dong, Honglei Fu, Fanbo Meng, Wei Sun
Based on the stable mineral skeleton structure of coal gangue and the good adsorption of nano-FeOOH, coal gangue-loaded nano-FeOOH (nFeOOH-CG) was successfully prepared via chemical precipitation.
